create.title: Separate hard and smooth direct-M1 menu minimax
create.statement_tex: For a literal residual M1 block put a=delta-ell and define the accepted direct numerical capacity C_dir(D,L;X) as the minimum of 1+D/L, 1+sqrt(LX/D)+D^(3/2)/sqrt(LX), and the audited TTY row X^[89(1+ell)+819delta]/1282. On the active triangle its exponent is min(a,(1-a)/2,[89(1+ell)+819delta]/1282), since the companion second-derivative exponent is smaller. Lift the residual U_1 to the unique hard profile and all smooth profiles separately. The limsup of the worst menu exponent is 1/3 on each parent. Literal witnesses are D_0=floor(sqrt X) and D_1=floor(sqrt X)/2 with full nonterminal L asymp X^(1/6) shells; their coordinates tend to (1/2,1/6), the elementary rows are X^(1/3+o(1)), and TTY tends to 770/1923=1/3+43/641. On the hard witness the accepted transform converts normalized L^2 capacity to physical X^(1/4)L^(1/2), against normalized target L^(3/2), so both parents miss by X^(1/12+o(1))=L^(1/2+o(1)). This is optimality of the accepted upper-bound menu separately on the two physical parent sets, not a lower bound for either actual signed sum.
create.next_action: Do not rescan the accepted direct rows. A direct continuation must prove a new sign-sensitive X^(1/12) gain on each literal critical parent, or one exact whole-U_1 theorem with a lawful owner map.

create.title: Adjacent hard and smooth profile telescope supplies no direct connector gain
create.statement_tex: For the accepted nested denominator profiles w_j=E_j-E_(j+1) and Vaaler height weights a_(H_j)(h), the exact scale identity is sum_(j=0)^J w_j(d)a_(H_j)(h)=E_0(d)a_(H_0)(h)-E_(J+1)(d)a_(H_J)(h)+sum_(j=1)^J E_j(d){a_(H_j)(h)-a_(H_(j-1))(h)}. Thus spatial telescoping retains all height differences and both boundary owners. At a fixed physical atom the original scale terms are nonnegative multiples of one common chi_4-character phase, so adding the hard and first-smooth profiles is aggregation rather than coefficientwise cancellation, while subtracting them is not the physical M1 sum. The equal X^(1/12) deficits do not define a connector. Raw profile telescoping, adjacent differencing, scale BV, and scale-only Abel summation therefore supply no missing power. This does not obstruct a new joint signed inequality across distinct lattice atoms or product fibres, and it is not a lower bound for the complete M1 sum.
create.next_action: Work after the complete scale sum with a genuinely joint signed inequality, or use the separate GAR backup. Do not claim a gain from profile addition, equal deficits, or scale-only telescoping.

The one-count assembly remains complete and requires both direct parents. Their accepted menus now have certified separate one-third witnesses; equal deficits and adjacent profile addition do not merge the leaves.

The global menu optimum is now sharpened to separate hard-M1 and smooth-M1 physical witnesses. Any exponent below one third still requires a new signed estimate; menu capacity remains distinct from an arithmetic lower bound.

On the direct route, prove both separately one-third-critical parents with the missing X^(1/12) gain. On the alternative route, prove both global radial parents and GAR, then use only the separate total-M1 bridge; GAR does not prove blockwise M9-M1.

At the limiting critical point its exponent is 770/1923=1/3+43/641, strictly larger than the elementary one-third contact.
The hard cone must be converted by X^(1/4)L^(-3/2). Its physical coefficient-blind row is X^(1/4)L^(1/2), not L^2 in physical B_1 units.
The equality X^(1/12)=L^(1/2) is only a capacity comparison. The two blocks have different profiles, heights, endpoints, and owners.
The exact telescope retains height differences and top/bottom owners, while original scale atoms have one common character phase and nonnegative scale weights.
The canonical Gram is post-global, owns only one transformed component, remains open, and has no inverse localization to a literal direct block.
GAR controls only the total active M1 aggregate and enters a separate global bridge. It implies no individual block and no blockwise M9-M1.
The result concerns the minimum of proved upper-bound right sides. A new sign-sensitive inequality may still be smaller.
The accepted physical one-count assembly requires the conjunction of the hard and smooth direct parents.
